name: agent-index-solo
description: Tier-P F1 installer witness: install ONLY agent-index from a pinned release or explicitly materialized candidate. Preserve inactive/dormant and metadata-only session checks, explicit repository opt-in, installation-policy/activation governance, configured client/host role reads, owned incomplete-slot repair through first-use provisioning, strict completed-profile/no-role rejection, actual venv/CLI version, installation-owned HTTP health/status and direct MCP tool registration. Never build or start the embedding engine or a model. Stop at the first real obstacle; no synthetic completion receipts or hand-install workaround.
validates: released agent-index explicit adoption, actual installer readiness and lightweight service reads
